rules_evaluated.rule_lead: What You'll Learn shape — capability register
rules_evaluated.evidence: Bullets lead Diagnose/Pair/Build/Assemble/Re-send — concrete, engineer-recognizable verbs. No Bloom-tag parentheticals, no author-defence asides, no didactic taxonomy stamps. Verbs are not from AE101's 7-verb theme list (Compound/Earn/Mirror/Ground/Introspect/Sharpen/Capture), but §7 explicitly licenses construction/pairing verbs (Build, Pair, Match, Assemble) for concrete artifact lists over theme verbs whose grammar wouldn't fit — matches exactly ('Pair each failure mode with the packaging that catches it', 'Assemble the reference artefact + plan.md'). Bullet 3's parenthetical menu (background-agent, shell-hook, Ralph re-feed) names the shapes functionally without attributing Cherny, matching the strategy doc's explicit split ('Phase 3 names the menu; attribution lives in [closing lecture]').
